acceptance: SSB row-count references at SF 0.01, 0.1, 1 and 10 are regenerated from native data with the library generator version in provenance.
Legacy-data SSB and synthetic bundles are separated from native ones by data_generation_hash in Explorer cohorts.
Local SSB and synthetic suites are re-run and submitted by PR to published-results with zero unapproved cloud spend.
description:
## Problem
Native SSB (specification counts, new RNG) and native synthetic data differ from legacy, so row-count references and published bundles built from legacy data go stale at each cutover. The existing re-baseline item covers TPC Parquet only.

## Change
Regenerate references from native data and re-run local suites after each cutover.

## Decision gates
- No live-cloud spend without owner approval; cloud bundles stay marked pre-change.
- Never mix legacy-data and native-data bundles in one cohort.

## Guardrails
- BenchBox work only in a linked worktree; heavy work only through make heavy-run; never kill processes by name pattern.
- No divergent fork of tpcgen-rs; carried patches only under the 2026-11-27 rule (<= ~200 changed lines, upstream PR, SHA pin, README entry); anything larger goes to the owner with sizes first.
- Human commit identity, no agent attribution. Report only observed results.
